text: DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-16), option A: no identity at relays ever. Writes gated by epoch access proof; registrations by billing key; storage/bandwidth by RSA quotas. Remaining reads/connections/subscriptions/push registration limited per network address and per channelToken; relay MAY require proof-of-work challenge under load (fair to Tor users sharing exit IPs). Delete client-relay DID challenge-response handshake (§11.6) — only survived for KP store, moved off relay by Q3. Privacy Pass deferred as possible future extension.
